description: Moon phase for any place and date: phase name (new, crescent, quarter, gibbous, full), whether it is waxing, approximate illuminated fraction, days from the nearest full moon, the dates of the next full moon and next new moon, moonrise and moonset with bearings, and the moon's highest point. Answers "is it a full moon tonight" and "when is the next full moon" for stargazers, anglers, photographers and night walks. Source: MET Norway Sunrise 3.0 for rise, set and phase angle; full and new moon times are our own calculation (Meeus lunar-phase formulas, accurate to a few minutes) and illumination is approximate. Needs lat and lon: for a UK place name or postcode, get coordinates from geocode or postcode_lookup first. (cost: 1 credit)

date.description: string, optional, day as YYYY-MM-DD, default today (at utc_offset)

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

utc_offset.description: string, optional, UTC offset for the times returned (-12:00 to +15:00), e.g. +00:00, +01:00 for UK summer time, default +00:00

name: moon_phase
